<panel>
	<parent>DLabel</parent>
	<realm>Client</realm>
	<file line="">lua/vgui/dlabeleditable.lua</file>
	<description>
		An editable <page>DLabel</page>, double click on it to edit.

		This is used in the spawnmenu spawnlist headers.
	</description>
</panel>


<example>
	<description>Creates a DLabelEditable.</description>
	<code>
local EditLabel = vgui.Create( "DLabelEditable" )
EditLabel:SetPos( 40, 40 )
EditLabel:SetSize( 70, 30)
EditLabel:SetText( "Hello, world!" )
	</code>

</example>
